changeRecord.title: units relabelled without conversion
changeRecord.whyItMatters: Every dimensional number of the file is read in the declared units, so relabelling them describes a different physical structure: lengths, sections, loads, stiffnesses and strengths all scale by powers of the unit factor. Because the unit system is consistent the model stays self-similar: the NUMBERS of the results in file units and all design ratios are unchanged -- nothing inside the file looks wrong. The error shows only against physical data stated outside the file (a span given in metres, a load in kN, a deflection limit in millimetres): every physical result is off by the unit factor.
changeRecord.precondition: any model (the declared units are part of every file)
